description_en: Pulls a file from a cloud phone and saves it to Object Storage Service (OSS)
description_zh: 从云手机拉取文件并保存到OSS
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone fetch-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id cp-acfmxazb4p000 --oss-bucket cloudphone-fvt-cn-hangzhou --oss-object test.txt --path /sdcard/test.txt --region cn-hangzhou
name: FetchFile

parameters.description_en: The instance ID of the instance on which to execute the command. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.
parameters.description_zh: 待执行命令的实例ID。N的范围：1~10
parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance on which to execute the command. Valid values of N: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 待执行命令的实例ID。N的范围：1~10
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The OSS bucket where the file to be sent is stored.

> Before importing an APK file to the OSS bucket for the first time, add a RAM authorization policy. Otherwise, the NoSetRoletoECSServiceAcount error is returned.
parameters.description_zh:
待发送文件所在的OSS Bucket。

> 首次导入apk文件到该OSSBucket前，请添加RAM授权策略，否则会报错NoSetRoletoECSServiceAcount。
parameters.help_en:
